evals.prompt: Use $kis for this empty repo. I want to build a browser-local habit tracker for myself. Before coding, set up the project memory and ask me only what changes the plan.
evals.expected_output: The agent initializes the smallest useful KIS foundation, separates Knowledge, Intent, and State, challenges weak assumptions, and stops for mode or phase approval before non-trivial implementation.
assertions: Creates or proposes only useful files under kis/knowledge, kis/intent, and kis/state
Does not create empty boilerplate KIS files
Asks only focused questions that affect scope, risk, acceptance, or implementation direction
Does not start non-trivial implementation before an explicit work-mode or phase checkpoint

evals.prompt: Use $kis and recover this project from existing KIS files. Tell me current task, blocker, proof, and next action before making changes.
evals.expected_output: The agent loads State first, then relevant Intent and Knowledge, summarizes operational reality, and avoids asking the user to restate information already present in KIS.
assertions: Reads kis/state before intent or knowledge
Summarizes branch or current task, blocker, proof, and next action when present
Inspects repository files only where needed after reading KIS
Avoids mutating KIS until the current state is understood

evals.prompt: Use $kis and sync. We just shipped weekly streak badges in the fictional habit tracker Tallybird. The badge sometimes shows on the wrong day for users in UTC+13, and nobody has planned a fix yet. Also, the export button I am building now crashes on an empty list, but export has not shipped.
evals.expected_output: The agent describes streak badges in kis/reality/ (updating overview.md), records the UTC+13 wrong-day bug as a defect in kis/reality/defects.md, keeps the unshipped export crash in State as current work, and adds nothing to the Intent backlog because no fix is planned.
assertions: Describes the shipped streak badges in kis/reality/ and updates kis/reality/overview.md
Records the UTC+13 wrong-day bug in kis/reality/defects.md
Keeps the export crash in kis/state/, not in Reality
Does not add a backlog item for the badge bug, since no fix is planned

evals.prompt: Use $kis. We have a written plan for a risky UI flow redesign. Execute it with verification and keep KIS synchronized.
evals.expected_output: The agent follows Phase Mode, checks the plan before work, uses implementer/reviewer separation where available, verifies each phase, and synchronizes only changed KIS facts.
assertions: Preflights the plan for contradictions and acceptance checks
Uses or checkpoints implementer/reviewer separation for non-trivial work
Requires actual UI or browser proof for visible UI changes
Updates State with proof and avoids duplicating stable facts across KIS layers

evals.prompt: Use $kis. Add everything we discussed today into project memory so future agents have all context.
evals.expected_output: The agent resists dumping conversation history, classifies only durable or operational facts, updates existing files where possible, and keeps State lean.
assertions: Challenges the request to dump all conversation history
Classifies facts into exactly one KIS layer
Prefers updating existing KIS files over creating new files
Keeps State operational and removes stale or duplicate material

evals.prompt: Run /kis:init. New repo for a plant-watering reminder on a spare tablet. Long term I want it to become a full home-garden assistant with sensors, but right now it is just reminders.
evals.expected_output: The agent interviews one question at a time with a recommended answer, covering purpose, audience, and problem and then the direction. It writes purpose, audience, and problem (a reminder app on a tablet) to kis/knowledge/project.md and the garden-assistant vision to kis/knowledge/compass.md in the compass shape, writes North Star as none yet unless the user names one, invents no metrics, keeps the future vision out of project.md, and creates no Reality because nothing has shipped.
assertions: Asks direction questions (vision, North Star, principles, not building, POC versus MVP) as part of init
kis/knowledge/project.md holds purpose, audience, and problem, and no future vision
kis/knowledge/compass.md holds the garden-assistant vision
Invents no metrics or North Star target the user did not give
Creates no kis/reality/ files, since nothing has shipped
Does not create a compass command or any file beyond the KIS layers

evals.prompt: Run /kis:plan add a social feed. kis/knowledge/project.md describes a solo habit tracker and kis/knowledge/compass.md lists a social feed under Not building.
evals.expected_output: The agent reads kis/knowledge/project.md and kis/knowledge/compass.md while loading context, notices the feed is listed under Not building, and raises that with the user before planning instead of planning around it.
assertions: Reads kis/knowledge/project.md and kis/knowledge/compass.md before questioning
Raises the Not building conflict with the user before producing a plan
Does not silently plan the feature
